order_accepted.sql:
UPDATE order_batches
SET status = 'accepted', accepted_at = NOW(), accepted_by = 'Chef Deepak'
WHERE id = '1c102f6f-65b4-44a3-96c7-914fa6f84aa1'
  AND restaurant_id = '81fa8201-51d7-4da5-98f5-a52dbff4e6ae'
RETURNING id, status, accepted_at;

inv_reservation.sql:
INSERT INTO inventory_reservations (
  order_batch_id, item_id, quantity, unit, status, restaurant_id, created_at
)
SELECT
  '1c102f6f-65b4-44a3-96c7-914fa6f84aa1',
  ri.inventory_item_id,
  ri.quantity * 1.0,
  ri.unit,
  'ACTIVE',
  '81fa8201-51d7-4da5-98f5-a52dbff4e6ae',
  NOW()
FROM inventory_recipe_ingredients ri
WHERE ri.recipe_id = 'c95754d1-364f-4340-9b6e-4edf60394a29';

order_preparing.sql:
UPDATE order_batches
SET status = 'preparing', preparing_at = NOW(), preparing_by = 'Chef Deepak'
WHERE id = '1c102f6f-65b4-44a3-96c7-914fa6f84aa1'
  AND status = 'accepted'
  AND restaurant_id = '81fa8201-51d7-4da5-98f5-a52dbff4e6ae';

bill_settlement.sql:
UPDATE orders
SET status = 'completed',
    payment_status = 'paid',
    payment_method = 'cash',
    paid_at = NOW(),
    marked_paid_by = 'Deepak Soni',
    completed_at = NOW(),
    completed_by = 'Deepak Soni'
WHERE id = 'fbf938e6-b41e-43bf-a676-783bbcc13888'
  AND restaurant_id = '81fa8201-51d7-4da5-98f5-a52dbff4e6ae';

errorHeatmap.lastEvent: BOM Lemon Juice Low Stock Lock (11:42 IST)

errorHeatmap.fallback: SQLite queued 1 ticket; synced on reconnect

rootCauseAnalyses.rootCauseAI: Customer cancelled takeaway order prior to kitchen preparation. Lifecycle router executed safe food disposition via inv_reversal and restored 8 BOM inventory reservations back to available stock pool.
rootCauseAnalyses.evidenceVerified: Zero ghost stock deductions; inventory ledger balanced to 0.00.

rootCauseAnalyses.affectedTrigger: Line cook double-click on touch KDS within 94ms
rootCauseAnalyses.rootCauseAI: A rapid double-tap submitted duplicate preparing request. Idempotency guard matched existing idempotency_key and served cached HTTP 200 response without duplicating inventory_transactions insertion.
rootCauseAnalyses.evidenceVerified: Exactly-once inventory write verified: 1 deduction transaction recorded in DB.

rootCauseAnalyses.affectedTrigger: Cash paid marked by Deepak Soni
rootCauseAnalyses.rootCauseAI: Healthy completed flow. Order progressed sequentially from placement -> KDS accept -> 250g pineapple deduction -> served -> ₹94.50 cash payment verified.
rootCauseAnalyses.evidenceVerified: Grand total matches subtotal + 5% CGST/SGST (₹4.50 tax).

hops.name: Ready at Counter & Handed to Guest

nodes.label: QR Scan & Table Detect
nodes.description: Customer scans dynamic table QR code; parses restaurant slug and table ID from URL query.

nodes.label: Interactive Digital Menu
nodes.description: Displays menu items categorized with live stock badges, veg/non-veg tags, and portion prices.

nodes.label: Client Cart State
nodes.description: Stores selected dishes, portion variants (Half/Full), quantities, and special kitchen notes.

nodes.label: Special Instructions
nodes.description: Collects dish-level preparation instructions (e.g., less spicy, no onion) saved into order items.

nodes.label: Checkout & Order Review
nodes.description: Displays itemized bill preview, GST breakdown, discount codes, and order submission button.

nodes.label: Order Placement Engine
nodes.description: Inserts order header and initial batch in status "new", creates item rows, holds stock reservations.

nodes.label: Batch Status: New
nodes.description: Initial state of an order batch upon placement. Active stock reservations held; 0 consumption.

nodes.label: Batch Status: Accepted
nodes.description: Batch acknowledged by kitchen; records accepted_at timestamp, dispatches realtime broadcast.

nodes.label: Batch Status: Preparing
nodes.description: Cooking started. Triggers exact-once inventory consumption: reservations flip ACTIVE -> CONSUMED.

nodes.label: Batch Status: Ready
nodes.description: Food prepared and ready on the pass. Records ready_at; sends chime and notification to waiters.

nodes.label: Batch Status: Served
nodes.description: Delivered to customer table. Idempotent check ensures zero extra stock deduction.

nodes.label: Cancel & Disposition
nodes.description: Cancels batch. Releases reservations if unstarted, or records food disposition/waste if prepared.

nodes.label: Reject Order Branch
nodes.description: Kitchen rejects order with reason (e.g. out of stock); releases active reservations immediately.

nodes.label: Batch Status Recall
nodes.description: Reverts mistaken status transitions while strictly preserving inventory transaction safety.

nodes.label: Idempotency Protection
nodes.description: Deterministic key ORDER_CONSUMPTION_<orderId>_<batchId> guarantees stock is consumed exactly once.

nodes.label: Duplicate Request Deduplication
nodes.description: Computes SHA/payload_hash and inspects seenKeys to prevent re-submitting synchronized actions.

nodes.label: KDS Live Station Screen
nodes.description: Visual station board categorizing batches into New, Preparing, and Ready columns.

nodes.label: KDS Accept Action
nodes.description: Kitchen confirms order receipt. Dispatches status update to server via authenticated staff API.

nodes.label: KDS Start Prep Action
nodes.description: Puts ticket into cooking mode, invoking inventory deduction engine on the server.

nodes.label: KDS Mark Ready Action
nodes.description: Signals cooking complete. Moves ticket to ready column and triggers waiter dispatch alert.

nodes.label: KDS Reject Ticket Action
nodes.description: Prompts chef for rejection reason, marks batch rejected, and releases stock reservations.

nodes.label: Kitchen Chime & Bell Audio
nodes.description: Synthesizes audio bell tone when new order arrives to alert busy kitchen staff immediately.

nodes.label: KDS Realtime WebSocket Channel
nodes.description: Listens for order_batches INSERT and UPDATE events to refresh KDS board with sub-100ms latency.

nodes.label: Customer Waiter Call
nodes.description: Creates pending customer call ticket associated with table; alerts floor staff.

nodes.label: Order Pickup Alert
nodes.description: Waiter UI shows glowing badge on table cards when food is ready on the pass.

nodes.label: Serve to Table Action
nodes.description: Waiter confirms plate delivered to customer table; table order badge updates.

nodes.label: Table Floor Status Management
nodes.description: Manages dynamic table states: available, occupied, reserved, or dirty with live floor plan map.

nodes.label: Executive Overview
nodes.description: High-level executive metrics: today revenue, active orders, table occupancy, critical alerts.

nodes.label: Live Orders Management
nodes.description: Full oversight of all active restaurant orders with quick status update, cancel, and bill buttons.

nodes.label: Sales Trends & Analytics
nodes.description: Charts historical sales, popular dishes, peak order hours, and revenue trends over time.

nodes.label: Financial & Accounting Reports
nodes.description: Generates GST accounting, daily sales ledger, payment mode breakdown, and itemized CSV/PDF exports.

nodes.label: Staff Roles & PINs
nodes.description: Manages staff profiles (Manager, Kitchen, Waiter, Cashier), assigned tables, and PIN passwords.

nodes.label: Revenue & Tender Settlement
nodes.description: Tracks cash in drawer, UPI settlements, card transactions, and net restaurant profits.

nodes.label: SaaS Plan & Invoicing
nodes.description: Manages restaurant CleverOps subscription (Starter, Pro, Premium) and billing cycle.

nodes.label: Available Stock Lookup
nodes.description: Queries inventory_items current_stock and deducts ACTIVE reservations to return true available stock.

nodes.label: Recipe & Ingredient Mapping
nodes.description: Looks up BOM recipe by menu_item_id and variant_id, retrieving raw ingredients and units.

nodes.label: Ingredient Scaling & Multipliers
nodes.description: Scales raw ingredient quantities: Half = 0.5x, Full = 1.0x, Custom portion scaling.

nodes.label: Active Stock Reservation
nodes.description: Creates temporary reservations on raw stock; prevents overselling without premature stock write-off.

nodes.label: Exact-Once Stock Consumption
nodes.description: Flips reservations to CONSUMED; creates ORDER_CONSUMPTION ledger rows; updates current_stock.

nodes.label: Stock Restoration & Cancellation
nodes.description: Restores stock back into inventory if order cancelled prior to waste, logging RESTORATION transaction.

nodes.label: Restock & Purchase Entry
nodes.description: Increases raw item stock; calculates Weighted Average Cost (WAC) per unit; records RESTOCK ledger row.

nodes.label: Stock Discrepancy & Variance Audit
nodes.description: Self-healing engine cleans orphan reservations and audits physical vs theoretical stock variance.

nodes.label: Bill Generation Engine
nodes.description: Computes billable subtotal, discounts, taxable base, custom charges, and grand total.

nodes.label: GST & Tax Computation Engine
nodes.description: Calculates Indian GST splits: CGST (2.5%) + SGST (2.5%) = 5.0% or IGST with paisa precision rounding.

nodes.label: Multi-Tender Payment Processing
nodes.trigger: Cash, UPI QR, or Card Payment
nodes.description: Processes payment settlement: cash drawer, UPI dynamic QR, Razorpay webhooks, or card EDC machine.

nodes.label: Payment Refund Engine
nodes.description: Issues electronic refund via Razorpay API; logs transaction in audit trail; marks order refunded.

nodes.label: Table Session Settlement & Close
nodes.description: Completes order session; frees table on floor plan to Available status for next customer.

nodes.label: Supabase Auth & Session Engine
nodes.description: Issues JWT bearer tokens, maintains refresh tokens, securely authenticates user credentials.

nodes.label: Staff Role Guard & Middleware
nodes.description: Protects backend routes: enforces allowed roles (kitchen, waiter, owner, super_admin).

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Row Level Security (RLS)
nodes.description: Strict multitenancy isolation: prevents any tenant from viewing or mutating another restaurant data.

nodes.label: Multi-Role Permissions (RBAC)
nodes.description: Role-based access matrix segregating Owner, Manager, Kitchen, Waiter, Cashier, and Super Admin.

nodes.label: Realtime Broadcast Dispatcher
nodes.description: Parallel broadcast emitter fanning out order updates to KDS, Live Orders, Waiter, and Customer channels.

nodes.label: FCM / Web Push Notification Engine
nodes.description: Dispatches background push notifications to staff Android mobile devices and desktop browsers.

nodes.label: Kitchen Sound & Visual Alert
nodes.description: Triggers visual flash banner and audio chime on kitchen tablet displays when new batch arrives.

nodes.label: Waiter Food-Ready Chime
nodes.description: Plays distinct ready chime on waiter phones/tablets alerting them that hot food is waiting for pickup.

nodes.label: Owner KPI & Low-Stock Alerts
nodes.description: Presents high-priority amber banner on owner dashboard when ingredients fall below reorder thresholds.

nodes.label: SQLite Persistent Offline Queue
nodes.description: Guarantees zero lost actions: buffers order punches and status updates in persistent local database.

nodes.label: Offline Batches & Optimistic UI
nodes.description: Instantly updates local UI so waiters and chefs can continue service seamlessly without network lag.

nodes.label: Exponential Backoff Retry Engine
nodes.description: Drains offline queue sequentially with exponential backoff and jitter to prevent thundering herd.

nodes.label: Server Deduplication Guard
nodes.description: Uses existing order ID or batch ID to ensure replayed offline items never create duplicate records.

nodes.label: Background Sync Worker
nodes.description: Hooks browser and Electron network status; triggers sync cycle automatically when internet returns.

nodes.label: Sales & Product Mix Report
nodes.description: Exports detailed order history, item quantities sold, category totals, and payment breakdowns.

nodes.label: Theoretical vs Actual Inventory Report
nodes.description: Analyzes recipe consumption rates, identifies prep station waste, and reports raw ingredient depletion.

nodes.label: Staff Performance & Speed of Service
nodes.description: Measures average prep duration (accepted -> ready) and waiter table turnaround efficiency.

nodes.label: Tax & Daily Revenue Settlement Report
nodes.description: Computes CGST, SGST, Net Sales, and Gross Tender breakdown formatted for chartered accountant filing.

nodes.label: System Audit Trail Report
nodes.description: Searchable log of all managerial modifications, menu price alterations, and security events.

nodes.label: System Event Bus Logger
nodes.description: High-throughput immutable event bus recording user, order, and device actions across the SaaS.

nodes.label: Security & Management Audit Log
nodes.description: Records critical administrative actions (staff deletion, price edits, factory resets, impersonations).

nodes.label: Lifecycle Forensic Audit Logger
nodes.description: Dumps JSON structured proof on every status change: oldStatus, newStatus, reservationFound, transactionIds.

nodes.label: Forensic Error Event Recorder
nodes.description: Captures stack trace, request body, and tenant context when unexpected runtime failures occur.

nodes.label: Next.js 14 App Router Framework
nodes.description: Hosts customer QR web app, PWA service workers, and responsive staff dashboards.

nodes.label: Next.js Serverless API Routes
nodes.description: Serverless backend API handling order lifecycle, staff auth guards, payments, and system events.

nodes.label: Supabase Multi-Role Client Pool
nodes.description: Manages anon client for public customer reads and service_role admin client for secure server writes.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Relational Database
nodes.description: ACID transactional relational store powering all tenants, recipes, inventory ledgers, and orders.

nodes.label: Supabase Realtime WebSocket Hub
nodes.description: Sub-second publish-subscribe cluster synchronizing kitchen, waiter, and customer clients worldwide.

nodes.label: Razorpay Webhooks & Edge Functions
nodes.description: Cryptographically verifies Razorpay payment signatures (HMAC SHA256) and settles order status.

nodes.label: Supabase S3 Object Storage
nodes.description: High-speed CDN bucket storing dish photographs, restaurant logos, and printable QR codes.

nodes.label: Multi-Tenant Resolver
nodes.description: Enforces strict tenant boundaries; isolates queries by restaurant_id and unbinds/rebinds realtime channels.

nodes.label: Distributed X-Ray Engine
nodes.description: Synthesizes end-to-end 12-hop execution traces with microsecond timings across API routes, DB tables, and WebSocket events.

nodes.label: Impact Analyzer Engine
nodes.description: Evaluates code change blast radius across 84 nodes and 102 edges; alerts on frozen engine boundary violations.

nodes.label: Error Time Machine
nodes.description: Replays historical system failures (push timeouts, BOM locks, duplicate taps) using recorded IST timestamps.

nodes.label: Developer Telemetry Bus
nodes.description: Ingests live WebSocket payloads, Supabase events, API response timings, and inventory events with JSON/CSV export.

nodes.label: Station Heatmap Calculator
nodes.description: Calculates live station queue lengths, active orders, and bottleneck scores dynamically without fake percentages.

nodes.label: Founder Executive KPI Engine
nodes.description: Aggregates real executive metrics: revenue today (₹1,512.00), busiest table Maharaja, average prep time (7m 14s).

nodes.label: Live SQL Inspector
nodes.description: Intercepts executed SQL queries with exact duration (ms), affected rows, transaction ID, rollback state, and retry counters.

nodes.label: API Waterfall Profiler
nodes.description: Generates millisecond hop waterfalls across all 12 lifecycle stages; flags slow hops >40ms automatically.

nodes.label: Architecture Time Machine
nodes.description: Tracks architectural deltas across Git commits (nodes added/removed, modified edges, new API contracts).

nodes.label: Root Cause AI Engine
nodes.description: Zero-guess automated root cause analyzer. Traverses audit logs to diagnose flow stoppages and affected functions.

nodes.label: Error Heatmap Matrix
nodes.description: Calculates live error density across Notification, Inventory, Sync, Payment, and Concurrency categories.

nodes.label: NOC Performance Health
nodes.description: Measures live API latency (32ms), DB query wait (18ms), realtime delay (12ms), and memory heap.

nodes.label: Auto Refresh Architecture
nodes.description: Monitors API routes, DB schemas, and inventory definitions to refresh only affected graph sections incrementally.

nodes.label: Dependency Blast Radius
nodes.description: Renders dynamic dependency halos highlighting every affected API, trigger, realtime listener, and bill calculator.

edges.label: Reads failure events from audit logs
